known_information: The0.99.1 report describes two distinct problems: Alt suppression delays the Photoshop Clone source cursor, and moving Photoshop/palettes remains problematic after switching to Win.
A later participant confirms the Alt conflict and reports improvement after changing the modifier; that does not validate Photoshop window movement.

Exact v0.102.3001 source and XAML expose excluded_apps and excluded_apps_for_modifier. IsModifierExcluded chains the original modifier event before absorption; IsExcluded separately rejects excluded target windows.
The release source still supports Alt or Win modifiers; arbitrary modifier chords are a separate feature request, not the demonstrated repair.
issue_context.analysis: The requested blacklist already has released prior art. A modifier-only exclusion can restore Alt while retaining movement; a full app exclusion addresses the separate window-movement conflict. Confirm whether those current settings cover the exact Photoshop process/windows before inventing another exclusion mechanism.
issue_context.summary: The current release already provides separate whole-app and modifier exclusions; test those before adding another blacklist.
initial_investigation: Read complete issue and the newer participant reply. Inspected both exclusion settings in the exact current release and traced modifier chaining before absorption versus target-window rejection.
No Photoshop installation, input injection, user settings change or arbitrary-chord implementation was performed.

information_gaps.why_needed: The requested blacklist exists already; remaining failure needs the exact exclusion boundary and window/process.

information_gaps.information: Whether the two existing current-release exclusion settings resolve their corresponding Photoshop symptoms

inferences: The Alt symptom is consistent with modifier absorption, but the palette-movement problem may need a full process/window exclusion rather than only changing the modifier.

comment.body: The current 0.102.3001 release already has two separate Grab and Move exclusion lists. Please try the actual Photoshop/Elements executable in the modifier-key exclusion list for the Alt/Clone-source cursor problem. If the separate window/palette movement issue remains, try the whole-app exclusion list as well. Could you report which symptom remains and the executable name you excluded? Changing Alt to Win only addresses the first interaction; it does not demonstrate that moving Photoshop windows is compatible. There is no need to reset all PowerToys settings or add another blacklist before checking these existing controls.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current release implements both requested exclusion boundaries. This is a verified available configuration path, not an independently reproduced Photoshop fix.
